# Copilot Instructions for This Repository

Scope: entire repository.

## Language Rules

- Write all code comments in English.
- Write all docstrings in English.
- Write inline explanatory notes in English.
- Keep identifiers and API names as-is unless a refactor is explicitly requested.

## Existing Non-English Text

- Do not change user-facing UI text, entity names, or localization strings unless explicitly requested.
- If you touch code with existing non-English comments, translate those touched comments to English.

## Review Rule

Before finalizing a change, quickly check modified files for newly introduced non-English comments and convert them to English.
